description: Re-scan every discovered Strapi project from disk and rebuild the index from scratch. Rarely needed: before every call the server already compares the project files with the disk and re-indexes what was created, edited or deleted outside this session (manual edits, git checkout/pull, another tool), and re-reads installed plugins after an install. Use it to discover a project added since startup, after external edits on a project whose `freshness.diskTracking` is 'off' (too many files), or with `cold: true` to also drop the cached plugin reads and read every installed plugin from node_modules again (slower). Returns the projects with their `freshness`.

cold.description: Also drop the cached plugin reads: every installed plugin is read again from node_modules (default false).

name: refresh
title: Re-index projects from disk (full rescan)
